Step:  
02-05-1015 is 1015-05-02 in ISO format.  
Subtract 180 days:  
1015 is not a leap year (divisible by 5? 1015/5=203, but leap year rule for Gregorian: divisible by 4, not by 100 unless divisible by 400; 1015 not divisible by 4).  
Days in months before May: Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30 → total 120 days.  
From May 2, go back 180 days:  
First go back to Jan 1: from May 2 → back to May 1 (1 day), then April (30 days) → 31 total, March (31) → 62 total, February (28) → 90 total, January (31) → 121 total back to Jan 1.  
Need 180 days back: 180 - 121 = 59 more days back into previous year (1014).  
1014 is leap? 1014/4=253.5, not divisible by 4 → not leap.  
December 1014 has 31 days, so from Jan 1 1015 back 59 days:  
31 days into Dec 1014 → 31 days back, remaining 59-31=28 days back into Nov 1014.  
November has 30 days, so 28 days back from Dec 1 means date = Nov 3, 1014.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1014-11-03
